text: Control science and engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies the modeling, analysis, design and application of control systems. Its core lies in achieving precise regulation and control of "dynamic systems" through mathematical theories and engineering technologies. Its research objects cover scenarios ranging from industrial production lines and robots to spacecraft and intelligent transportation - for instance, the constant control of air conditioning temperature, the stable flight of unmanned aerial vehicles, and the parameter adjustment of chemical reaction vessels all rely on control theory and technical support. As the "nerve center" of modern technology, this discipline is deeply integrated with fields such as artificial intelligence, robotics, and new energy, and serves as the core foundation for intelligent manufacturing and Industry 4.0.
